Hana sits immediately after Finn, and Dev is exactly two slots after Hana (the other side of Hana puts Dev next to Finn, which breaks the Dev–Finn gap). Ivo is at least five after Hana, so Hana can only be in 2, 3, or 4. Ben is exactly two after Elif, and Gus is after Dev with exactly one slot between Gus and Ivo.

Hana in 4 leaves no slot pair for Elif and Ben. Hana in 3 always breaks the Ben–Ivo gap or the Ann–Ben gap. Hana in 2 leaves one placement that meets every order and gap. With Ivo in 9, Gus must be in 7 so Ann is the one person between them.
